incidents.name: PancakeBunny BunnyMinterV2 LP price manipulation
incidents.notes: BunnyMinterV2 sized the BUNNY performance-fee mint from the spot value of the WBNB-USDT LP reported by PriceCalculatorBSC, so a flash-loan-skewed Pancake pair made the vault's harvest mint ~7m BUNNY; the minter executed exactly as designed on a manipulated price.

sources.ref: onchain review: VaultFlipToFlip 0x633e538ecf0bee1a18c2edfe10c4da0d6e71e77b (in the attack tx logs) reports minter() == 0x8cb88701 (BunnyMinterV2), which is the contract consuming the manipulated LP price; minter proxy created 2021-03-10 by 0xe87f02606911223c2cf200398ffaf353f60801f7, last EIP-1967 Upgraded 2021-04-27, not attacker-deployed
